description: Pulls tasks from a connected issue tracker into a poker game. Give it either iteration_ref from poker.iterations.list to take a whole sprint, or query to search by text and issue key. Tasks already in the game are skipped. Only the team owner can change a game. Requires mcp:write scope.

game_id.description: The ID of the poker game to import into.

iteration_ref.description: The ref of an iteration from poker.iterations.list — imports every task of that sprint.

limit.description: How many tasks to pull at most. Default: 50, maximum: 100.

query.description: Text or issue key to search for, when importing without an iteration.

source.description: Tracker to import from, for example jira. Required only when the team has several trackers connected.

name: poker.game.tasks.import
title: Import Poker Tasks Tool
